arguments.command:
git checkout -q -b feat/38-no-agent-hooks
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='action.yml'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    - name: Install pi-agent git hooks
      shell: bash
      run: node ${{ github.action_path }}/scripts/install-agent-hooks.js
    
""","")
open(p,'w').write(s)
t=open('scripts/hooks.test.js').read()
t=t[:t.index('describe("install-agent-hooks"')].rstrip()+"\n"
t=t.replace('import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";','import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";')
t=t.replace('import { mkdtemp, readFile, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";','import { mkdtemp, readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";')
t=t.replace('import { installAgentHooks } from "./install-agent-hooks.js";\n','')
t=t.replace('"pi-action-hooks-"','"pi-action-prepare-commit-msg-"')
open('scripts/prepare-commit-msg.test.js','w').write(t)
EOF
git rm -q scripts/install-agent-hooks.js scripts/hooks.test.js
sed -n 136,145p action.yml; head -20 scripts/prepare-commit-msg.test.js
